features.description: Introduce the pure m-<slug>-<16hex> module-directory encoder and its injectivity, determinism, worked-example, and length tests without wiring production yet.
acceptance_criteria: encodeModuleDirName implements the approved lowercase ASCII slug, 38-byte slug cap, and first 16 lowercase SHA-256 hex characters over the full original module ID
TestEncodeModuleDirName_InjectivityAndDeterminism covers the approved examples, repeatability, a/b versus a__b, Foo versus foo, and the 57-character ceiling
Deleting the full-ID hash suffix makes the named M1 test fail
go test ./internal/pipeline/... -count=1 passes

features.description: Wire CacheStore.moduleArtifactDir to the real encoder, delete the old mapping, expose the narrow test-visible API, and migrate every discovered encoding-dependent fixture.
acceptance_criteria: CacheStore.moduleArtifactDir uses encodeModuleDirName and the old encoder is removed
The collision subtest asserts distinct production directories and retains exact-module-ID stamp rejection
All three hard-coded production modules/answer paths use the real directory resolver
The cmd/ailang compileArtifactDir fixture invokes the real exported encoder rather than copying it
Reverting production moduleArtifactDir wiring to the old mapping makes the rewritten collision integration subtest fail
go test ./internal/pipeline/... ./cmd/ailang/... -count=1 passes

features.description: Prove Windows legality and real artifact publication, remove the temporary empty-manifest skip, and wire both no-silent-skip CI gates to execute and require PASS events from both pipeline tests.
acceptance_criteria: TestEncodeModuleDirName_AllLegalOnWindows covers the approved fixtures, forbidden and control bytes, trailing dot or space, reserved basenames, and real os.MkdirAll on Windows
TestCacheArtifacts_WindowsModuleIDPublication stores and reloads C:/Users/runneradmin/x through the real encoded directory and emits an explicit named pass event
requireCompileArtifactCache no longer skips Windows empty manifests; an empty manifest fails everywhere

Both no-silent-skip CI go test package lists include ./internal/pipeline, both -run regexes name both new tests, and both required-PASS loops name both tests while preserving existing platform-specific entries
Windows CI reports explicit PASS events for both new tests
go test ./internal/pipeline/... ./cmd/ailang/... -count=1 passes locally before the remote Windows gate

features.description: Pin Clear() sweeping old- and new-scheme artifact directories and document why the directory rename does not require a cache-key version bump.
acceptance_criteria: TestClear_SweepsArtifactDirectories uses a real store and persisted manifest, creates old- and new-scheme directories, calls Clear(), reopens, and verifies directories plus persisted and in-memory entries are gone
The note adjacent to cacheKeyVersion explains that directory renaming is self-invalidating and changes neither blob nor stamp format
The test does not duplicate broader scope or error-ordering arms already covered by TestCacheStore_ClearArtifacts
